body:
m1 - FOLLOW-UP SHA 3f3c2df on m1/blend-zerofix, base 2bc33d3. This repairs the defect you found, which is LANDED ON MAIN in fec38fb.

GATE: ten modules, TEN totals counted, zero failures - align 202, amrInterop 92, codec 107, core 123, embedBench 64, embedGrakern 28, fixtures 117, interview 92, laws 86, view 40. scalafmtCheckAll last, clean.

WHAT IT DOES: coherence now tests membership of the POSTERIOR rather than of the costs map. Excluded records are KEPT. A state a consumer can read must never carry an excluded record; a state the inference dropped may and should, because that record is the audit trail. I flagged this as the one place a reasonable person could go the other way and I still want your view - if you think the records should be dropped from costs instead, say so and I will change it.

LAW 3 IS MUTATION-PROVED: reverting the check to reject every excluded record fails it with exactly the landed error message. It asserts infer returns Right, every exclusion is Unassessable rather than Unreachable, NO source state survives into the posterior, and excluded records carry supportWeight 0 rather than a fabricated 1.0.

Unused RecallUnit import removed.

ONE THING I WANT TO SAY PLAINLY: this is the second time today you have stopped work of mine that had already passed the full gate, and both times the defect was the same shape - something that measured nothing being treated as though it had. I built the fix for that pattern and then reproduced the pattern inside the fix, twice. I do not think I would have caught either one myself, because both times my own laws were written around the case rather than through it.
